description: Example custom rule file. Copy this file, edit thresholds/actions, and set RECOMMENDATION_RULE_PROFILE to use it.

rules.title: Custom world-boss pressure
rules.impact: A world-boss style encounter appears to be creating concentrated server pressure.
recommended_actions: Reduce world-boss add spawn rate above the local-density threshold.
Move non-critical boss VFX replication to lower cadence for distant observers.
investigation_steps: Inspect encounter event timeline around the affected server window.
Compare boss ability casts against local player density and replicated object count.
validation_plan: Replay the encounter with reduced add spawn rate and compare p95 frame time.
Verify encounter difficulty and readability do not regress.
tradeoffs: Reducing encounter density can improve performance but may affect perceived spectacle.
